## Change

Describe the problem and what your patch changes. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and their results. For code changes, include `swift test` and the unsigned app build when relevant, or explain which checks you could not run.

## Contribution rights

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under Apache License 2.0, and I identified any third-party material and its required notices.
- [ ] I removed credentials, personal data, and private project material from this PR.

Public `main` contains release snapshots. Maintainers review contribution PRs here, apply accepted changes in private development, and link the public release when they close the PR. See `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
